h1:
Where to Stay in Pattani?
12 Hotels From Real
Guest Reviews
heroSub: 12 hand-picked Pattani stays across every budget — from a riverside boutique in the city centre to a private pool villa and a hostel inside the PSU campus. Covering the old town, Rusamilae, Sai Buri's beach and the Nong Chik countryside. From ฿350–9,000/night.
introH2: 🏙️ Why does choosing the right area in Pattani matter?
introHtml: Pattani is a small city, but its hotels are spread across several zones that each feel different — the old-town heart around Anoru is walkable to the Central Mosque, the Lim Ko Niao Shrine and rows of old shophouses · the Rusamilae area sits next to Prince of Songkla University (PSU) Pattani and suits anyone visiting the campus or hunting for value · the Pattani riverside is quieter with a view · and if you want to escape the city there's a Sai Buri beachfront resort and a Nong Chik farm stay · Many travellers book without checking the zone and end up driving back and forth all day · This guide rounds up 12 hand-picked Pattani stays across every level — from high-scoring boutiques to a hostel and a whole-house pool villa — each with real guest reviews, a 3-site price compare and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Pattani has no metro and no commercial airport of its own — most travellers fly into Hat Yai and transfer by road (about 1.5–2 hours), or drive/take a van. In town, driving or ride-hailing is easiest · The main lodging zones in this guide: City centre / Anoru old town — Central Mosque, Lim Ko Niao Shrine, riverside shophouses · Rusamilae — next to PSU Pattani, restaurants and cafes · Pattani riverside — quiet, with a view · Sai Buri beach / Nong Chik countryside — out-of-town resorts and farm stays.

entries.name: Santisook Midtown Pattani
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Riverside · city centre by Dechanuchit Bridge
entries.storyHtml: The highest score and most reviews in this guide at 9.8 from 208 reviews — Santisook Midtown is a newly opened riverside boutique in the heart of Pattani, right by Dechanuchit Bridge, walkable to the Anoru old town and markets · Real reviews praise the spotless, almost-new rooms, attentive staff and river views from the Superior rooms · Rooms start spacious at 29 sqm with a Smart TV throughout, and at ฿1,700 it's strong value for the location and condition.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: if budget allows, choose a Superior Double on the river side — the evening view over the Pattani River is the highlight — and book ahead, as this is the most popular stay in town.
pros: Highest score in the guide, 9.8 from the most reviews (208)
Riverside in the city centre, walkable to the old town
Newly opened, spotless rooms from a spacious 29 sqm
Superior rooms come with a Pattani River view
cons: Popular — rooms fill fast on weekends, book ahead
Newly opened, so fewer shared facilities than a big hotel

entries.name: CS Pattani Hotel
entries.addr: 99/9 Moo 4, Nong Chik Road, Rusamilae, Mueang Pattani District
entries.storyHtml: CS Pattani is the city's main full-service 4-star hotel, scoring 9.0 from 52 reviews · It's a complete hotel with a restaurant, meeting rooms and ample parking, suiting business travellers, conference guests and families alike · It sits in the Rusamilae area near PSU Pattani · Real reviews praise the friendly service and spacious rooms — a dependable, standard hotel close to town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: travelling with kids or a group? The Family Room Deluxe (4 beds) beats booking two rooms — and confirm whether breakfast is included, as some rates don't.
pros: The city's full-service flagship 4-star — dependable
On-site restaurant and meeting rooms for work/conferences
Ample parking if you're driving
Family rooms available for groups
cons: The building isn't new; some rooms are fairly plain
In Rusamilae, not the old town — you'll drive into the centre

entries.name: The Wood Pattani Hotel
entries.addr: 17/10 Moo 6, Charoenpradit Road, Soi 10, Rusamilae, Mueang Pattani
entries.storyHtml: The Wood Pattani is a warm, timber-toned boutique with plenty of reviews — 162 of them — scoring 9.0 · Its draw is the cosy, clean wood styling, and at just ฿1,100 it's strong value for a boutique room in the city centre · Real reviews praise the clean, quiet rooms and attentive staff · It's near cafes and restaurants, with easy getting around town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: the Deluxe Corner room has more windows and space for not much more — worth it if you like a bright, airy room.
pros: Plenty of reviews (162) with a steady 9.0
Warm timber design, clean and quiet rooms
From ฿1,100 — great value for a city-centre boutique
Near cafes and restaurants
cons: Small hotel — no pool or gym
Standard rooms are compact; pick Deluxe for more space

entries.name: The Grand Pool Villa Pattani
entries.storyHtml: The Grand Pool Villa is the most upscale option here — a private whole-house pool villa, scoring 8.4 from 36 reviews · It has 4 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, a private pool and a full kitchen, sleeping around 17, ideal for a large family or group wanting their own space · Per person it's good value with a big group · Real reviews praise the pool and the spacious grounds — great for a party or family reunion.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: the rate is per house, not per person, so the bigger your group the cheaper per head — confirm the max headcount and long-weekend terms before booking.
pros: Private pool and roomy whole-house grounds
4 bedrooms, sleeps ~17 — ideal for big groups/reunions
Full kitchen, so you can self-cater
Good per-person value with a large group
cons: Highest per-house price here — not for a couple
Suburban, so you'll drive into town and there's no hotel service

entries.name: The Stay Inn Pattani
entries.addr: Ban Rusamilae area, Mueang Pattani (near PSU Pattani)
entries.storyHtml: The Stay Inn is a high-scoring whole-house rental at 9.4 from 20 reviews · It has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and sleeps around 6, with a full kitchen, washing machine, balcony and private parking — ideal for a family or group wanting house-style privacy · It's in the Rusamilae area near PSU Pattani · Real reviews praise the cleanliness and the value when you split it among several people.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: staying several nights? Ask for the long-stay rate — and with a kitchen and washing machine you'll save on meals and laundry.
pros: Whole house, 3 bedrooms, sleeps ~6 — scores 9.4
Full kitchen and washing machine, great for long stays
Private parking if you're driving
Good per-person value with a group
cons: It's a rental — no hotel-style service or all-hours check-in
Fewer reviews than the city hotels

entries.name: Southern View Hotel Pattani
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nong Chik Road · near PSU Pattani
entries.addr: 399 Moo 4, Nong Chik Road, Rusamilae, Mueang Pattani
entries.storyHtml: Southern View is an 80-room 3-star hotel on Nong Chik Road starting at just ฿900 · Its Agoda score is high at 9.4, though review numbers are still thin (5) as it's fairly new · The draw is the large room count, easy availability and value, with everything from Deluxe rooms up to a Suite · It's in the Rusamilae area near PSU Pattani — handy for anyone wanting a clean, budget room and driving themselves.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: the Deluxe Queen at ฿900 is the best value for two; step up to the Suite only if you want a separate sitting area.
pros: From ฿900 — good value for a 3-star
80 rooms, so availability even at short notice
Choice from Deluxe rooms up to a Suite
Near PSU Pattani with parking
cons: Few reviews (5) as it opened recently
On Nong Chik Road, not the old town

entries.name: Pattanipirom Boutique Hotel
entries.addr: 245/93-95 Moo 6, Na Songkhro Road, Rusamilae, Mueang Pattani
entries.storyHtml: Pattanipirom is a loft-style boutique with its own in-house coffee roaster, scoring 9.0 from 11 reviews · Its draw is the cafe atmosphere and loft-styled rooms; each has a Smart TV with Netflix, and rates start at ฿1,400 · It suits coffee lovers and anyone who likes a cafe vibe · It's in the Rusamilae area on Na Songkhro Road · Real reviews praise the good coffee and the nicely styled rooms.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: pick a Standard King with a window or the Deluxe for more light and space — and try the cafe's house-roasted coffee in the morning.
pros: In-house coffee roaster, nice atmosphere
Loft-style rooms with Smart TV/Netflix
From ฿1,400 — good value for a boutique
Great for coffee lovers and a cafe vibe
cons: Some rooms have no window — check the room type first
Few reviews so far (11)

entries.name: BM Pattani Apartment
entries.addr: Charoen Pradit Road, Rusamilae, Mueang Pattani
entries.storyHtml: BM Pattani Apartment is the best-value private room here, from ฿600, scoring 9.0 from 47 reviews · Rooms have a fridge and water heater, and some have a terrace, making it a good pick for budget travellers wanting a clean private room in the Rusamilae area near PSU Pattani · Real reviews praise the value and helpful staff — it works for both short and long stays.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: the Studio with terrace is roomier for not much more — worth it for a multi-night stay — and ask for the long-stay rate if you're around for a while.
pros: From ฿600 — best value among private rooms here
Clean rooms with a fridge and water heater
Some rooms have a terrace · family room available
Near PSU Pattani, good for short and long stays
cons: It's an apartment — no hotel-style service
Single rooms are compact; pick the Studio for more space

entries.name: River City Hotel Pattani
entries.addr: 2/99 Moo 1, Charoen Pradit Road, Rusamilae, Mueang Pattani
entries.storyHtml: River City is a midrange riverside hotel with a pool and plenty of reviews — 96 of them — scoring 8.1 · Its selling point is the pool, which is rare among Pattani stays, plus Superior rooms with a balcony over the river · It's on Charoen Pradit Road, near both the city and PSU Pattani · Real reviews praise the pool and location, though some note the rooms are dated — so pick a renovated one.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: choose a Superior River View for the balcony over the river, and ask about the room's condition when booking, as some are newer than others.
pros: Has a pool — rare among Pattani stays
Superior rooms have a balcony over the Pattani River
Plenty of reviews (96) · near city and PSU
Suite available for families or longer stays
cons: Some rooms are dated — pick a renovated one
Overall score of 8.1 isn't as high as the top boutiques

entries.name: Nee Ran Nee Resort Pattani
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pa Se Ya Wo · Sai Buri
entries.addr: 59 Moo 2, Pa Se Ya Wo, Sai Buri District
entries.storyHtml: Nee Ran Nee is a budget beachfront resort in Sai Buri District, scoring 8.7 from 11 reviews · Its selling point is the spot near the beach plus rooms ranging from 2 guests up to a group room for 8 — very cheap per person with a big group · It suits anyone wanting to get out of town for a seaside break · Real reviews praise the quiet atmosphere and value, though it's a fair drive from Pattani city.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: coming as a group or a big family? Book a 6–8 guest room for a very low per-person cost — and check the distance from town first, as it's out in Sai Buri.
pros: Near the beach with a quiet seaside vibe
From ฿800 · group rooms for up to 8
Very low per-person cost with a big group
Good for an out-of-town break
cons: In Sai Buri District, a fair drive from Pattani city
A 2-star resort with basic facilities

entries.name: Blue Lapan Inn Pattani
entries.addr: 181 Charoenpradit Rd (Sai Maw), Rusamilae, Mueang Pattani
entries.storyHtml: Blue Lapan Inn is the cheapest stay in this guide, with dorm beds from just ฿350, scoring 8.6 from 20 reviews · It sits inside the PSU Pattani campus, ideal for anyone visiting the university, students or budget travellers · It has gender-separated dorms plus private rooms from singles up to a King · Real reviews praise the cleanliness and the campus location — a good pick if you don't need lots of facilities.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: solo and on a budget? Book a dorm bed — but as a couple the private double at ฿750 beats two dorm beds.
pros: Cheapest in the guide — dorm beds from ฿350
Inside the PSU Pattani campus, handy for university visits
Both dorm beds and private rooms available
Clean, good for budget travellers
cons: A hostel with basic facilities
Dorms share common space — less private than a room

entries.name: Bakkahland Farm and Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Don Rak · Nong Chik · out of town
entries.addr: 54 Moo 4, Tambon Don Rak, Nong Chik District
entries.storyHtml: Bakkahland is a Malay-style wooden-house farm stay in the Nong Chik countryside, scoring 8.2 from 40 reviews · Its draw is the quiet rural setting; the raised wooden houses have a balcony looking over the fields and garden, and rates start at just ฿500 · It suits anyone wanting to escape the city for simple, natural stay · Real reviews praise the atmosphere and the owner's warmth, though it's out of town so you'll need a car.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: pick a Bungalow (wooden house) with a balcony over the fields for the full experience over a Standard room — and bring a car, as it's out of town.
pros: Quiet rural farm setting by the fields
Malay-style wooden houses with field-view balconies
From ฿500 · family bungalow available
Friendly owner, great for a simple getaway
cons: In Nong Chik District out of town — you'll need a car
A 2-star farm stay with basic facilities

advice.bodyHtml: → Blue Lapan Inn dorm beds from ฿350 inside PSU · or BM Pattani Apartment ฿600 for a private room with terrace · or Bakkahland ฿500 wooden-house farm stay

advice.head: Want to stay in the city centre
advice.bodyHtml: → Santisook Midtown ฿1,700 riverside in the heart of town, scores 9.8 · or The Wood Pattani ฿1,100 a city-centre boutique near cafes

advice.head: Travelling as a family or group
advice.bodyHtml: → The Stay Inn ฿1,300 a whole house with 3 bedrooms · or The Grand Pool Villa ฿9,000 a whole-house pool villa sleeping ~17

faqTitle: FAQ — common traveller questions about Pattani hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area is best to stay in Pattani?
faq.a: It depends on your style · The city centre / Anoru old town suits walking to the Central Mosque, Lim Ko Niao Shrine and old shophouses (Santisook Midtown, The Wood) · Rusamilae suits anyone visiting PSU Pattani or after value (CS Pattani, BM Apartment, Southern View) · The riverside is quiet with a view (River City) · And to get out of town there's a Sai Buri beachfront resort and a Nong Chik farm stay.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Pattani hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: hostel dorm beds from around ฿350 · budget apartments and private rooms around ฿500–900 · boutiques and 3–4 star hotels around ฿1,100–1,900 · and a private whole-house pool villa from around ฿9,000 (sleeps many, so good per-person value with a big group) · Prices can rise over long weekends and festivals.

faq.q: ❓ Does Pattani have an airport — how do I get into town?
faq.a: Pattani has no commercial airport of its own · Most travellers fly into Hat Yai Airport (HDY) and transfer to Pattani in about 1.5–2 hours by van, coach or rental car · Once in town, driving yourself or ride-hailing is easiest, as Pattani has no metro.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Pattani hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) vary by promotion and season, so it's worth comparing all three before every booking — each review page in this guide has the price-compare links, which can save several hundred baht a night.

faq.q: ❓ Coming to Pattani as a group or big family — where should we stay?
faq.a: With several people, a whole-house stay is better value · The Stay Inn is a whole house with 3 bedrooms sleeping ~6 at ฿1,300, with a kitchen and washing machine · The Grand Pool Villa is a 4-bedroom pool villa sleeping ~17 from ฿9,000 with a private pool · Or Nee Ran Nee Resort has group rooms for up to 8.

faq.q: ❓ Visiting PSU Pattani — where's the closest place to stay?
faq.a: The Rusamilae area is closest to (and inside) PSU Pattani · Blue Lapan Inn is right on campus, with dorm beds from ฿350 · BM Pattani Apartment and Southern View are near the university from ฿600–900 · And CS Pattani Hotel is the full-service hotel option in the same area.
